# Paisaxe - Discover Asturias

> Your personal guide to explore Asturias, Spain. Discover landscapes, routes, gastronomy, and culture through immersive visual stories.

## About

Paisaxe (pronounced "pai-SHA-shay", from Asturian for "landscape") is an immersive tourism experience for Asturias, a region in northern Spain. Visitors explore the region through full-screen visual stories and can ask questions via voice or text to learn more about each location.

Website: https://paisaxe.es
Alternative domain: https://paisaxe.com

## What Paisaxe Offers

- **Visual Stories**: Full-screen, immersive photography showcasing Asturias' most beautiful locations
- **Conversational Discovery**: Ask questions about any place, dish, or activity
- **Multiple Categories**: Nature, Cities, Food, Culture, Activities
- **Three Regions**: Eastern Asturias (Picos de Europa), Central Asturias (Oviedo, Gijón), Western Asturias (Cudillero, Luarca)

## Key Topics Covered

### Nature & Landscapes
- Lagos de Covadonga (glacial lakes in Picos de Europa)
- Naranjo de Bulnes (iconic mountain peak)
- Playa del Silencio (secluded beach)
- Ruta del Cares (famous hiking route)
- Bufones de Pría (coastal blowholes)
- Bosque de Muniellos (largest oak forest in Spain)

### Cities & Towns
- Oviedo (capital city, pre-Romanesque architecture)
- Gijón (coastal city, beaches, cider culture)
- Avilés (historic old town, Centro Niemeyer)
- Llanes (colorful fishing village)
- Cudillero (picturesque coastal amphitheater)
- Luarca (white village by the sea)

### Gastronomy
- Fabada Asturiana (bean stew with chorizo and morcilla)
- Sidra (traditional cider culture)
- Cachopo (breaded veal stuffed with ham and cheese)
- Queso Cabrales (famous blue cheese)
- Arroz con Leche (rice pudding dessert)

### Culture
- Pre-Romanesque architecture (Santa María del Naranco, San Miguel de Lillo)
- Camino de Santiago (Primitive Way, Northern Way)
- Descenso del Sella (international kayak festival)
- Festivals and traditions

### Activities
- Hiking in Picos de Europa
- Beach hopping along the Costa Verde
- Cider house tours (sidrerías)
- Cave art (Tito Bustillo, El Sidron)

## Languages

- User interface: Spanish
- Chat responses: Multilingual (responds in visitor's language)

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js
- Uses Claude AI for conversational responses
- Vector search for relevant content retrieval
- Optimized for mobile and desktop
